notes.title: Patch Notes - Update 2
notes.content:
Gameplay & Mechanics
• Adjusted the price of the Mega Pack to $5.99.
• Activated the Report Player button.
• Checkpoints were not working correctly for clients – this issue has been fixed.
• Goal Rush: Players who close the application now properly leave their team.
• Goal Rush: Reduced match duration from 6 minutes to 5 minutes.
• Goal Rush: Improved ball physics for smoother gameplay.
• Added "GOAL!" text after a goal is scored, with colors based on the scoring team.
• Sumo: Improved SUMO mode physics, making movement more responsive.

Bugs & Fixes
• Fixed an issue where players could shoot the ball even when it was controlled by another player.
• Fixed an issue where barriers were not removed after a shot following an opponent’s goal.
• Fixed ball physics issues to improve movement consistency.
• Fixed geometry errors in Bouncy Race that caused collision problems.
• Fixed gamepad synchronization issues, ensuring proper input detection.
• Fixed various lobby joining issues that could prevent players from entering properly.
• Fixed a bug that prevented music volume from being adjusted after returning to the lobby.
• Fixed Discord presence issues, ensuring proper status updates.

UI & Audio
• Improved UI in the main menu for better clarity in some sections.
• Improved various sound effects, adding click sounds to certain buttons for better feedback.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Update
notes.content:
Gameplay & Mechanics

Player Collision: Fixed issue where player collision didn’t work when two players were moving towards each other at the same time. 
Player Joining: Players now correctly join immediately when the game is launched. 
Double Jumping: Fixed issue with double jump count text not displaying in the correct location. 
Bouncy Race End Menu: The end menu now properly displays after completing a Bouncy Race. 
Bouncy Race Tree Collision: Collisions with tree crowns in Bouncy Race have been added. 
Bouncy Race Pause Issue: Players can no longer control their character after pausing and returning to the game post-race. 
Mouse Kick Issue: Fixed issue where kicking didn’t work using the mouse. 
Goal Rush Team Change: Fixed issue where players could change teams during a Goal Rush match. 
Goal Rush Power Bar: Added the power bar for shots in Goal Rush mode. 

Bugs & Fixes
Collision Fixes: Fixed multiple collision issues. 
Sumo Bots: Now functioning properly in solo Sumo mode. 
Booster Reset: Boosters now reset when returning to the lobby. 
Goal Rush: Fixed various issues related to Goal Rush mode. 
Emoji Randomizer: Fixed bug where emojis didn’t appear on exit or input properly. 
Bouncy Race Barriers: Fixed issue where barriers didn’t push the ball correctly in Bouncy Race. 
Gem & XP Scaling: Fixed issues with gem and XP scaling. 
Goal Rush Respawn Issue: Fixed issue where, if a player left during a Goal Rush match, the remaining players wouldn’t respawn correctly. 
Goal Rush Issue: if an entire team leaves the game, the match will end automatically.
Bouncy Race Skip Issue: Fixed bug where players couldn’t skip intro in Bouncy Race. 
Input & Localization Fixes: Fixed various input and translation issues. 
Endless Mode Distance: The distance is now always displayed in Endless mode. 
Goal Rush Optimization: Optimized performance in Goal Rush mode. 

UI & Controls
Mouse Button Play Issue: Fixed issue where the Play button had to be held with the mouse. 
Play Button in Lobby: The Play button now disappears when there is only one player in the lobby. 
Skip Button for Online Bouncy Race: The skip button now appears for online Bouncy Race matches. 
Map Completion: Map now fully completed and properly displayed. 
Boosters in Goal Rush: Boosters have been added to Goal Rush mode. 
Win Stats: Win counts are now properly displayed in the stats. 
Endless Run Respawns: Fixed issue with respawn rotation in Endless Run. 
Input at Start: Both keyboard and gamepad inputs are now detected immediately at the start of the game (for selected input). 

Lobby & Multiplayer
Host Escape Key Bug: Fixed issue where pressing Escape in the settings as the host caused a crash. 
Goal Rush Game Exit: Fixed issue with players being unable to leave a Goal Rush match. 
Endless Run and Sumo Menu Inputs: Fixed input issues and added PC controls for Endless Run and Sumo menus. 
Distance Reset Issue in Endless Run: Fixed bug where distance wasn’t resetting correctly in Endless Run mode. 
Lobby Joining Bug: Fixed issue where the lobby would require two attempts to join. 
Offline Player Addition: Fixed bug where offline players could still be added to the lobby. 
Lobby Bug with Offline Players: Fixed issue where two offline players would cause a lobby bug. 
Key Bind Fixes: Fixed keybinding issues and restored default settings functionality. 
Cancel Lobby Join: You can now cancel joining a lobby if the "Connection..." message appears.

Miscellaneous
Bouncy Race Map Completion: Finished additional Bouncy Race map details. 
Bouncy Race Particle System: Fixed particle system issues in Bouncy Race mode. 
Achievements: Steam achievements have been added for the game. 
Timer Issue in Bouncy Race: Fixed bug where the timer didn’t start when the first player finished in solo Bouncy Race mode (local). 
Lobby Exit Lag: Removed lag when exiting the lobby. 
Language Change Option: Players can now change the game’s language in the settings. 
Lobby Crash: Fixed the crash that occurred when joining a lobby after already being in one. 
UI Icons: Fixed issue where the icons at the top of the UI weren’t scaling properly. 
Sumo Start Issue: Fixed bug where players could fall off the sumo arena before the match started. 
Gamepad Pause Issue: Fixed issue where the gamepad’s "1" button didn’t work to unpause. 
Skip Map Issue in Bouncy Race: Fixed issue where players couldn’t skip the map after selecting "Play Again". 
Play Again Bug in Sumo: Fixed issue where "Play Again" didn’t work on the first attempt in Sumo mode. 
Lobby Connection Timeout: Fixed issue where players couldn’t connect to a lobby if they didn’t join within 30 seconds. 
Smooth Camera in Goal Rush: Camera movement in Goal Rush mode is now smoother. 
Sumo Fixes: Fixed multiple bugs in the Sumo mode. 
Sumo Play Again: Fixed issue where "Play Again" didn’t work in Sumo mode. 

To-Do List
Disconnecting Player from Lobby upon Nickname Change: Implement functionality to disconnect a player from the current lobby if they change their nickname.
Display Current Double Jumps in Main Menu: Add a feature to show the current number of double jumps in the main menu.
Add Bots to Goal Rush: Implement bots in Goal Rush mode to provide a more engaging experience for solo players or incomplete teams.
Fix Bots in Solo Sumo: Resolve issues with bots not functioning properly in solo Sumo mode.
Allow Offline Player Removal: Add functionality to remove an offline player from the lobby if needed.
Add Bonus for Goals Scored in Goal Rush: Implement a bonus system based on the number of goals scored during a Goal Rush match.
